summary: Nine reviewed slices are pushed with passing CI. Primitive visual/second-axis support and native-compatible deferred pose errors are in independent review.

active.title: Visual, second-axis and deferred-pose review
active.detail: Isolated candidate passes 45 Rust tests and 8 tool tests; coverage1677/1698 lines and2889/3001 regions. Two unchanged upstream nested-frame ports and76 native acceptance cases, including4 deferred pose failures, await independent acceptance. Explicit validation API is prepared for atomic scene consumers.

accepted_slices.title: Reject unaccounted Cargo targets and coverage inputs
Attribute owned implementation to Open Source Robotics Foundation
Preserve optional joint axes and the SDF 1.7 semantic subset
Preserve native legacy XML lexical and scalar semantics
Preserve exact self poses and local frame precision
Resolve model and include placement frames through semantic graphs
Enforce SDF frame scopes and root model constraints
Validate typed IMU configuration and reconcile runtime source ledger
Implement semantic SDF loading and strict staged quality gates

remaining: Complete native scalar prefix/coercion parity; retain documented native inertial-frame limitations and extend explicit consumer validation with supported features.
Complete retained schema/version conversions, include merge, automatic inertia and import/export semantics.
Remaining sensor families, visual/material/mesh DOM, serialization and CLI.
Full assertion/fixture equivalence for retained upstream cases, reproducible reference build, fuzzing and comparative benchmarks.

quality.note: Exact published quality slice passed strict staged-tree verification and hosted CI:39 Rust tests,8 tool tests; production1622/1643 lines,2774/2885 regions. No exclusions.
